item.label: Велосипеды у школьного квартала
item.requirements: Two bicycles / four wheels, chunky disc centres and one rack. Reference uses simplified toy bikes without a visible drivetrain; accepted as static toy design. Do not add thin spokes or chains. All four wheels must share ground plane.

specialQA: Four wheel contacts; complete two bicycle silhouettes; all wheel discs remain opaque. Static group, no wheels animated.
